"""Run unchanged BPP tests against staged exports and this run's fresh report."""
import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import sys
import unittest

STAGE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
FRONT = Path('/workspace/shared/urp_sync/current/src/frontend')
RESEARCH = Path('/workspace/shared/urp_sync/current/data/bpp/records')
sys.path.insert(0, str(FRONT))
context = STAGE / 'bpp_test_context'
(context / 'artifacts').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
shutil.copyfile(STAGE / 'bpp_artifacts/validation_report.json', context / 'artifacts/validation_report.json')
suite = unittest.TestSuite()
for name in ('test_import', 'test_validation', 'test_conversion', 'test_export_parity'):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, FRONT / 'tests' / (name + '.py'))
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    if name == 'test_export_parity':
        module.RESEARCH = RESEARCH
        module.OUTPUT = STAGE / 'bpp_exports'
        module.ROOT = context
    suite.addTests(unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromModule(module))
result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
sys.exit(0 if result.wasSuccessful() else 1)
